short.text: Jackson Jeffcoat, an undrafted rookie from Texas, signed with Jacksonville in May 2014 and joined the practice squad after being waived at the final cuts; his NFL level is not yet established. At Texas he was a productive edge rusher with length, athleticism and a pass-rush record over four seasons. Setting the edge against the run and strength are his weakest areas, and injuries and a lean frame are part of his college history.
